cv.name: Hugo Paillard
cv.headline: Graphic Designer | Brand identity, editorial & packaging

Prepare print-ready files and check proofs with printers
Redesigned the packaging range for a Breton biscuit maker, used across 18 products

experience.title: Junior Designer
bullets: Packaging mock-ups and adaptations for food and cosmetics brands
Photo retouching and exports for e-commerce

education.details: Includes a six-month internship in a packaging agency
